EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE BALANGODA URBAN COUNCILUNDER SECTION 66A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of Member of Balangoda Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of Death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna, the recognized political party to whichSugath Indrajith Wadudurage the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1)(a) of the aforesaid Ordinance,to decide upon the member of that 10 Ellepola if Balangoda Urban Council who belongs to such party and is not disqualifiedunder Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared elected as a Member within aperiod of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominateEkanayaka Rajapaksha Basnayaka Mudiyanselage Akila Saliya Ellawala to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Raveendra Subhashana Wedage, returning officer of the Balangoda Urban Council, acting interms of Section 66A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that EkanayakaRajapaksha Basnayaka Mudiyanselage Akila Saliya Ellawala was elected as the Member of the 10 Ellepola of BalangodaUrban Council.
RAVINDRA SUBASHANA WEDAGE,Returning Officer,Balangoda Urban Council.
